evidence.quote: Sean Breslin Partner, Head of Compliance and General Counsel Sean joined Trinity Street in September 2023. He is a qualified solicitor with significant legal and compliance experience over more than 25 years. After 5 years at the London law firm Norton Rose Fulbright, where he qualified and specialised in banking and finance related matters, Sean spent over 15 years at the FCA authorised and regulated Gordian Knot Limited where he was General Counsel. Sean then moved to the UK premium listed asset manager River and Mercantile Group Plc where he was General Counsel and Group Head of Compliance and was registered with the SEC as the Chief Compliance Officer for its US business. Whilst at the River and Mercantile Group Sean sat on the Risk Committee. Compliance Committees, Product Governance Committee, ESG Committee and was a member of the Senior Leadership Group.
